checkpoints.decision_summary: The idle notebook held three CPUs beyond the planned idle duration; active work consumed CPU and the one-CPU request remained pending
checkpoints.label: Policy off: work remains blocked

checkpoints.decision_summary: The notebook ended with idle-timeout; waiting work started while the active CPU control remained running above the same threshold
checkpoints.label: Idle capacity reclaimed automatically

checkpoints.decision_summary: A newly created session read the same saved-file SHA-256 from the vfolder
checkpoints.label: Saved file restored in a fresh session

checkpoints.decision_summary: All owned sessions ended and allocated CPU returned to zero
checkpoints.label: All allocations released

configuration.identities: One generated administrator account; names describe workload roles
configuration.metric_interpretation: Backend.AI 26.9.7 exports cumulative CPU milliseconds for cpu_used/current. The seeded five-minute rate preset converts milliseconds per second to millicores. cpu_util/current is not used because this release exports the raw cumulative measurement there before applying its internal rate hook.

experiment.limits: CPU demonstration; does not measure GPU performance or preserve process memory
experiment.name: Idle allocation reclaimed while active work survives
experiment.sampling_limit: Session and agent queries are sequential, not an atomic snapshot
experiment.scope: Actual CPU sessions, measured utilization, idle policy and persistent vfolder

measurements.interpretation: Observed timings include periodic checks and polling
